breakdown.description: The stress expression 3PL/(4bd^2) is a four-point bending formula, not the usual three-point bending relation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification continues to use the incorrect formula σ_f = 3PL/(4bd^2) and even explicitly states it 'matches the test geometry for a rectangular bar in three-point bending.' The ground truth requires σ_f = 3PL/(2bd^2) for three-point bending. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency and instead reinforced the error.
